reviewer_comment: R2-2: What about differences is "information" storage needs for your approach compared to others?
scope: Frozen primary Lorenz and CSTR models, Lh=M=20. No new scientific fitting or checkpoint changes.
input: First original training trajectory for each system, common origins 20..275; original train-fitted normalization. No test data.
inference_probe: Same CUDA device and float32; original neural code including diagnostics. RBF inference-only torch adapter reproduces original numpy equations and H20 rolling history; float64 native parity and float32 deviation checked before comparison.
training_probe: Original neural loss and Adam groups, one warmup and three measured full steps on disposable in-memory copies; restores checkpoint weights before each measured step. No saved model updates. Report allocator peak including moment state and separate incremental peak beyond resident model/batch/Adam. RBF is closed-form: analytic main-array sizes at common N=47500, not a measured Adam or total fitting peak.
inference_peak_definition: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated minus resident model/input allocation immediately before rollout; includes outputs, diagnostic copies and auxiliary tensors; excludes caching-reserved memory, CUDA context, host dataset and Python metadata.
